notes.title: v1.16 to v1.18 - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello Puropu Defenders!

Thank you so much for sending your feedbacks and bug reports!

Patch Notes from v1.16 to v1.18

Multiplayer & Networking  
  
 Fixed clients not receiving enemy counts at wave start.  
 Added network sync for shop item resets.  
 Disabled unnecessary network sync for object scale/rotation.  
 Fixed Army Plane death effects/VFX not appearing for clients.  
 Resolved crashes during rapid upgrades or lag.  
  
Maps & Level Design  
  
WesternDesert: Improved ground colliders and ramp placement.  
AncientEmpire: Fixed blocked stairs.  
Nuclear Plant:  
    
   Fixed visual glitches.  
   Fixed infinite unlock bug for objectives.      
Gameplay & Balance  
  
 Increased delay before ending waves for smoother transitions.  
 Reduced repetitive voice line frequency.  
 Fixed talent panel bugs and talent loading issues.  
  
Performance & Optimization  
  
 Optimized meshes for better performance.  
 Reduced overly loud voice volumes.  
 Cleaned up debug logs and warnings.  
 Fixed invisible enemies and co-op spawn issues.  
 Improved wave manager stability with failsafes.  
  
Bug Fixes  
  
 Fixed waves ending prematurely.  
 Fixed negative enemy counters.  
 Resolved "Gasha Machine" activation bugs.  
 Fixed client-side rapid upgrade issues.  
 Added missing in-game translations.  
  

Thank you for your continued support!  
Report issues via Steam Discussions or our support portal.  

Join our Discord or drop a message in Steam's forums if you want to have a chat with us! :)

notes.title: v1.14 - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello Puropu Defenders!

Thank you so much for sending your feedbacks and bug reports! You have so many great ideas, please keep them coming! 

New map: Nuclear Plant!

Step into the Nuclear Facility, a glowing green factory with toxic rivers, huge reactors, and chaos around every corner! Fight through shifting paths in our craziest map yet.

This map brings 2 new mechanics: Gates that open and close, shifting enemy paths in real-time, and speed boosts that let enemies zip past your defenses like they’re late for dinner. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/e824f1cc4c655c0949c08acbd1584334d0a331aa.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/557dfbb1090fa4b49deb9a2cbbcf68dc3e92a037.png

Here's a list of what has changed in v1.14:
- Added: new map Nuclear Plant  in 4 modes (Normal, Elite, Heroic, Infinite)
- Added: Nuclear Plant Infinite worldwide leaderboards
- Flying Enemies: Introduction of a new Flying Enemy notification, plus early AI/pathfinding improvements.
- Core Gameplay Fixes: Ensured T4 unlock logic works properly, stabilized Hero/Research point saving, and blocked certain values (like Character Points) from going out of range.
- Fixed: Pause Menu navigation logic
- Fixed: Settings not being properly saved/applied
- Fixed: Character Points exceeding 30
- Fixed: T4 upgrades not showing correctly on the Defense Card
- Improved: Ground Colliders in Desert Corridor
- Fixed: Flying Enemies pathfinding
- Added: Flying Enemy notification
- Improved: Research Lab texts
- Updated all translations
- Various UI fixes and improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.65: Community requests, bugfixes and optimizations!
notes.notes:
Puropu Defense Squad 0.65 IS LIVE!
PATCH NOTES:- [Submit feedback In-game] Press F7 in the menu or in-game to bring the feedback form that will allow you to send what you think or noticed, attached with the game logs and a in-game screenshot.
- [FIXED] Laser Turret projectiles sometimes do not hit their target
- [FIXED] Western Desert: re-arranged the placement of all the ceiling buildable spots on the map.
- [FIXED] Character health UI is rendered above the settings UI, blocking some of the options
- [FIXED] Hit box for selling/upgrading defenses (towers, traps, and barricades) is a bit strange for all defenses. Unsure if they all have the same hitbox issue but to upgrade the ice trap I have to aim my mouse at one of the corners to be able to upgrade it.
- [FIXED] When removing more than 75% of a boss's health it becomes impossible to read the health value since it is black text on the black background of the health bar.
- [FIXED] Unable to jump while on top of barricades
- [FIXED] Seemingly getting stuck/caught while walking near barricades making me unable to jump unless I move away from the barricades and try again
- [FIXED] After purchasing an item in the shop, when the camera re-focuses on another item the description of that item is not visible, you need to change the item for the description to become visible again. It might seem like the description is being shown for the item to the right of the one you purchased in the shop.
- [FIXED + little optimizations of most of the items models]
- [FIXED] The airplane enemies sometimes fly sideways or backwards after seemingly not rotating when changing direction
- [FIXED] When using the shotgun secondary for Mr.Box I was expecting there to be somewhat more spread on the damage cone, currently it feels like it is a very tight spread or even the same as the primary weapon.
- [FIXED] When at the game over screen maybe there should be a return to main menu button
- [FIXED] I'd second an earlier suggestion about making it possible to look up further before being stopped by the game to make it easier to interact with defenses placed on the ceiling.


Thank you for your help and support!
Keep the bug reports and requests coming on our, Discord and Steam forums! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Massive update: 2 new heroes, 2 new maps, and more!
notes.notes:
Hello Puropu Defenders,

We just released the biggest patch of Puropu to date! A massive amount of content, features, quality-of-life additions, fixes and optimizations are all included!

2 new characters to unlock: 


 Grey

Grey is the leader of the Techno-Props, originally a genius engineer, protected by her two robots, she decided to join the fight when she realized she could amplify her brainwaves to incapacitate humans. She also equipped herself with a rocket launcher filled with missiles, just in case.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/1f45dd944e140581262f4cf69952353369421d6f.png



 Tomusashi

A tomato samurai bored and tired of his life, wants to do one last thing before he becomes rotten, a true challenge for a true samurai. Tomusashi is a super-fast character that harnesses the power of electricity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44411601/255099bcd42e81bcd1c9ab46c93bb571a5911ad1.png

2 new maps to unlock:

 Western Desert: 
A town lost in the arid desert, vultures are circling, tumbleweeds are tumbling, Puropu is building.

 The Pit:
 A sandbox-type of map with an open field, to be free of building the craziest maze possible (especially in Inifinite mode)

Quality-of-life improvements:

 Puropu Defense Squad is entirely playable with your favorite gamepad!
 Adapted to widescreen (3440 x 1440)
 Translations improved
 Mega optimizations: you can now build hundreds of traps without seeing an impact on FPS
